item.title: Road pricing: drivers will get refunds for delays
item.description: The government introduced road pricing in the Budget last month. Drivers of EVs will now have to pay extra money for every mile driven. However, like the refunds for delayed train journeys, drivers will be able to claim for a refund if their trip is delayed by roadworks, accidents, bad weather, or acts of God.
